method.validation_status: exploratory; these windows were already observed in prior research
method.future_confirmation: rerun unchanged on a later prospective 252-session window
method.missing_policy: as-of last completed close; skip state until every material has 21 observations
method.forecast_clock_policy: max(latest material close before outcome, previous target close); always strictly before outcome
method.pairing_policy: intersection on target and timestamp with identical actual outcome, then shared 252-session windows
